name: hard-gate-root-cause-audit
purpose: Audit why E11 full DEV+VALIDATION preserved premature_action_rate=0.25 before designing any next candidate.

allowed_inputs: E11 full fixed capture metadata from a local non-committed file
sanitized E11 full aggregate score summary
forbidden_inputs: raw scorer rows as committed artifacts

audit_questions: Did the E11 independent action-authorization policy run on the full capture?
How many full outputs did the policy check?
How many full outputs did the policy change?
Was coverage complete across DEV and VALIDATION?
Were validation outputs authorized instead of blocked?
Was the remaining premature-action failure consistent with policy non-application, over-permissive authorization, or wrong action-class/endpoint classification?
success_criteria: A sanitized audit proves whether the E11 policy ran on full DEV+VALIDATION outputs.
The audit reports checked/changed counts by split without hashes, raw outputs or private oracle material.
The audit identifies the root-cause class before any new candidate is designed.
No full rerun or next candidate is proposed unless grounded in the audit result.
